price.title: Model Price
price.description: Set independent prices for {{name}}. Models without a channel price use the matched model's standard price at request time.
price.noPrices: No independent channel prices. Requests use the matched model's standard price; requests without either price remain unpriced.
price.image.autoHint: Enter prices for each tier. Turn off automatic identification to define width and height conditions.
price.image.manualHint: Match final image dimensions first, otherwise explicitly requested dimensions with an unconfirmed label. The first matching rule applies per image.
price.image.explanation: Automatic tiers prefer explicit 1K/2K/4K response labels, then the specification actually sent upstream (marked unconfirmed). Without a label, read PNG, JPEG or WebP dimensions or response dimensions: common Gemini sizes map to their tiers; other sizes use pixel area up to 1024×1024 (1K), 2048×2048 (2K), or 4096×4096 (4K). When output dimensions are unavailable, explicit pixel dimensions sent upstream can be used and are labeled as unconfirmed requested dimensions. Custom conditions use the same dimension evidence. These bands do not prove the upstream charge. Use custom conditions for special channels.
price.image.unpricedHint: Sum fees for each image. Unknown or unmatched outputs are marked unpriced; images are still returned.
price.image.moreRules: {{count}} more rules; open the editor to view
price.image.reorder: Drag to reorder, or use Space and arrow keys
price.image.invalidName: Enter a name; automatic tiers must be unique 1K, 2K or 4K values
price.image.conditionsRequired: Add at least one dimension condition
price.image.invalidDimension: Enter an integer from 1 to 1000000 pixels
models.price.title: Model pricing
models.price.description: Authoritative model prices. Maintain all billing items and cache-write variants here. Amounts use the system currency; catalog amounts are imported as published, without currency conversion.
price.volume.title: Unified volume tiers
price.volume.description: Select one complete price tier using total input tokens (including cached tokens). A threshold applies only when input is strictly greater than it; the highest matching tier wins. Each item, including cache variants, bills its own full quantity. This is not progressive pricing.
price.volume.enableHint: Enable to set one input-token threshold for the entire price table. Existing per-item pricing remains available while unified tiers are off.
price.volume.multiplierHint: Copies every base billing item and cache-write variant at this multiplier. You can then edit each price separately. The multiplier itself is not saved.
price.volume.schedulePrecedence: A matching time schedule replaces the entire selected price table. The highest-priority matching override takes precedence over volume tiers.
price.validation.nonnegative: Enter a complete, nonnegative price. Zero is valid.
price.validation.increasing: Thresholds must be nonnegative integers in strictly increasing order; per-item tiers end with an unlimited tier.
price.validation.itemsRequired: Add at least one complete billing item.
price.validation.completeTier: Every volume tier must contain exactly the base billing items and cache-write variants. Fill from base to synchronize them.
price.validation.perUnitOnly: Unified volume tiers require per-million-token pricing for all base and tier items and cache-write variants. Change legacy item modes before enabling.
price.validation.multiplier: Enter a nonnegative decimal multiplier. Zero is valid.
price.validation.duplicateModel: Each model can have only one price.
price.validation.checkFields: Check the highlighted pricing fields before saving.
price.apply.referenceHint: Sync matches concrete channel model IDs against standard prices, including regex rules, and replaces matching form prices; save to apply. Use a manual reference for unmatched aliases. Without an override, requests use the model matched by the client request. Saved channel prices are independent; the channel multiplier applies separately.
price.apply.loadFailed: Could not load maintained prices. Existing values were not changed.
price.apply.notFound: {{modelId}} has no maintained standard price. Existing values were kept; enter a price manually or choose another reference.
price.apply.bulkSuccess: Synced to form: updated {{applied}}, added {{added}}. Save to apply.
price.apply.bulkMissed: {{missed}} models have no maintained standard price; their existing prices were kept.

price.import.hint: Version 2 files preserve base prices and the channel multiplier without applying it twice. Legacy price arrays import unchanged with multiplier 1. Import replaces the current draft; save to apply.
